1: // Simple Asteroid Miner game
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas>
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
8:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Sound assets (using simple public domain sounds)
11:   const thrustAudio = new Audio('https://freesound.org/data/previews/341/341695_6244725-lq.mp3'); // short thrust
12:   thrustAudio.loop = true;
13:   const mineAudio = new Audio('https://freesound.org/data/previews/331/331912_3248244-lq.mp3'); // mining beep
14:   const crashAudio = new Audio('https://freesound.org/data/previews/353/353539_4017125-lq.mp3'); // crash
15:   const bgMusic = new Audio('https://freesound.org/data/previews/331/331912_3248244-lq.mp3');
16:   bgMusic.loop = true;
17:   bgMusic.volume = 0.2;
18:   bgMusic.play();
19: 
20:   // Ship
21:   const ship = {
22:     x: WIDTH / 2,
23:     y: HEIGHT / 2,
24:     r: 12,
25:     angle: 0,
26:     speed: 0,
27:     maxSpeed: 4,
28:     accel: 0.1,
29:     turnSpeed: 0.07,
30:     fuel: 1000,
31:     score: 0,
32:     alive: true,
33:   };
34: 
35:   // Asteroids pool
36:   const asteroids = [];
37:   const AST_COUNT = 30;
38:   for (let i = 0; i < AST_COUNT; i++) {
39:     asteroids.push({
40:       x: Math.random() * WIDTH,
41:       y: Math.random() * HEIGHT,
42:       r: 15 + Math.random() * 20,
43:       vx: -1 + Math.random() * 2,
44:       vy: -1 + Math.random() * 2,
45:     });
46:   }
47: 
48:   // Pre‑generated starfield
49:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
50:   const stars = [];
51:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
52:     stars.push({
53:       x: Math.random() * WIDTH,
54:       y: Math.random() * HEIGHT,
55:       c: 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5) + ')',
56:     });
57:   }
58: 
59:   // Input handling
60:   const keys = {};
61:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
62:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
63: 
64:   function update() {
65:     if (!ship.alive) return;
66:     // Controls
67:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.turnSpeed;
68:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.turnSpeed;
69:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.speed = Math.min(ship.speed + ship.accel, ship.maxSpeed);
70:     else ship.speed = Math.max(ship.speed - ship.accel * 0.5, 0);
71: 
72:     // Thrust sound handling
73:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.alive) {
74:       if (thrustAudio.paused) thrustAudio.play();
75:     } else {
76:       thrustAudio.pause();
77:       thrustAudio.currentTime = 0;
78:     }
79: 
80:     // Move ship
81:     ship.x += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
82:     ship.y += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
83:     ship.fuel--;
84:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) ship.alive = false;
85: 
86:     // Wrap around edges
87:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += WIDTH;
88:     if (ship.x > WIDTH) ship.x -= WIDTH;
89:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += HEIGHT;
90:     if (ship.y > HEIGHT) ship.y -= HEIGHT;
91: 
92:     // Update asteroids and check collisions
93:     for (const a of asteroids) {
94:       a.x += a.vx;
95:       a.y += a.vy;
96:       if (a.x < 0) a.x += WIDTH;
97:       if (a.x > WIDTH) a.x -= WIDTH;
98:       if (a.y < 0) a.y += HEIGHT;
99:       if (a.y > HEIGHT) a.y -= HEIGHT;
100: 
101:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
102:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
103:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
104:       if (dist < a.r + ship.r) {
105:         // Collision: if speed low, mine; else crash
106:         if (ship.speed < 1) {
107:           ship.score += Math.floor(a.r);
108:           // play mining sound
109:           mineAudio.currentTime = 0;
110:           mineAudio.play();
111:           // respawn asteroid
112:           a.x = Math.random() * WIDTH;
113:           a.y = Math.random() * HEIGHT;
114:           a.r = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
115:           a.vx = -1 + Math.random() * 2;
116:           a.vy = -1 + Math.random() * 2;
117:         } else {
118:           ship.alive = false;
119:           // play crash sound
120:           crashAudio.currentTime = 0;
121:           crashAudio.play();
122:         }
123:       }
124:     }
125:   }
126: 
127: function draw() {
128:     // Background gradient (space nebula)
129:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
130:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001020');
131:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000000');
132:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
133:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
134: 
135:     // Starfield background (pre‑generated stars)
136:     for (const star of stars) {
137:       ctx.fillStyle = star.c;
138:       ctx.fillRect(star.x, star.y, 1, 1);
139:     }
140: 
141:     // Asteroids with shading
142:     for (const a of asteroids) {
143:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.r);
144:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
145:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
146:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
147:       ctx.beginPath();
148:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
149:       ctx.fill();
150:     }
151: 
152:     // Ship with thruster effect
153:     ctx.save();
154:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
155:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
156:     // Thruster flame when accelerating
157:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.alive) {
158:       ctx.beginPath();
159:       ctx.moveTo(-ship.r, 0);
160:       ctx.lineTo(-ship.r - 8, -5);
161:       ctx.lineTo(-ship.r - 8, 5);
162:       ctx.closePath();
163:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
164:       ctx.fill();
165:     }
166:     ctx.beginPath();
167:     ctx.moveTo(ship.r, 0);
168:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r / 2);
169:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, -ship.r / 2);
170:     ctx.closePath();
171:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.alive ? '#0f0' : '#f00';
172:     ctx.fill();
173:     ctx.restore();
174: 
175:     // HUD
176:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
177:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
178:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${ship.score}`, 10, 20);
179:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${ship.fuel}`, 10, 40);
180:     if (!ship.alive) ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2 - 40, HEIGHT / 2);
181:   }
182: 
183:   function loop() {
184:     update();
185:     draw();
186:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
187:   }
188:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
189: })();

(End of file - total 189 lines)
